LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ThreatPointsPeak: Highest storyteller threat points recorded in save history (ThreatPoints at 0.5-day intervals, restored from internal 1/10 scale).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ThreatPointsLatest: Actual storyteller threat points at the final point of the save's ThreatPoints history. Opens the 0.5-day recorder curve in colony history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ThreatPointsMean: Mean of valid storyteller threat points across the save's ThreatPoints history. Opens the 0.5-day recorder curve in colony history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AdaptationLatest: Storyteller adaptation days at the final point of the save's Adaptation history (may be negative after colonist downs or deaths). Opens the 1-day recorder curve in colony history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AdaptationMean: Mean storyteller adaptation days across valid 1-day points in the save's Adaptation history. Opens the 1-day recorder curve in colony history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AdaptationPeak: Highest storyteller adaptation days recorded in the save's Adaptation history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AdaptationMin: Lowest storyteller adaptation days recorded in the save's Adaptation history (including negative values after losses).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_XenotypePeak: The highest count observed in a successful save, calculated separately for each Biotech xenotype.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BirthsBySpecies: Humanlike children born alive on the player's side, grouped by species at birth.
